profile_hash_rule: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON after removing profile_hash

scope.bbox_scope: workload-global union of value and full-gradient coordinates

canonical_numbers.signed_zero: normalize to positive zero before derived-matrix hashing
canonical_numbers.exact_input_model: each finite binary64 input is its exact dyadic value

execution_coordinate.runtime_binding: record Python, NumPy, actual threadpool controller records, loaded BLAS binary basename and SHA-256, platform, binary64, and thread environment before semantic judgment

coordinate_scaling.radius: max(abs(x - center)) over all workload value and gradient coordinates
coordinate_scaling.derivatives: differentiate normalized monomials with respect to physical coordinates
coordinate_scaling.materialization: round each exact derived entry once to binary64, ties-to-even

application.P_TOP: use the same workload transform as P
application.QTAQ: no; coordinate scaling would change kernel semantics

equilibration.row_exponent: zero for an all-zero row; otherwise -ceil(log2(max(abs(row))))
equilibration.column_exponent: after row scaling, zero for an all-zero column; otherwise -ceil(log2(max(abs(column))))
equilibration.arithmetic: power-of-two binary64 scaling; reject overflow; preserve zero rows and columns

rank_rule.ratio: sigma_min / sigma_max of the equilibrated matrix

precision_checker.activation: lazy; only after the binary64 analytic authority genuinely straddles tau_rank
precision_checker.exact_input_model: each equilibrated finite binary64 entry is its exact dyadic rational value
precision_checker.gram_orientation: form the smaller of A^T A and A A^T in exact rational arithmetic
precision_checker.eigenvalue_enclosure: exact Faddeev-LeVerrier characteristic polynomial, square-free Sturm chain, and requested-bit dyadic bisection of the least and greatest Gram roots
precision_checker.ratio_enclosure: propagate Gram-root intervals to sigma_min/sigma_max and round binary64 endpoints outward by exact rational comparison
precision_checker.resource_scope: all canonical P and P_TOP subjects are within the exact-checker caps; a larger QTAQ straddle may be denied after activation

certificate_encoding.human_readable: JSON finite number fields are retained for inspection
certificate_encoding.exact_binary64: every outward endpoint, envelope width, and tau_rank is also encoded with Python/C99 hexadecimal binary floating-point syntax
certificate_encoding.authority: the hexadecimal field is the exact serialization of each binary64 bound; decimal JSON text alone is not an authority encoding
certificate_encoding.unbounded_endpoint: the literal string inf is used only when the analytic enclosure is unbounded

f64_authority_checker.exact_structural_shortcuts: an all-zero matrix, or an exact dyadic zero row/column that prevents full min-dimension rank, proves the ratio envelope [0,0]
f64_authority_checker.rounding_model: binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even with gradual underflow
f64_authority_checker.runtime_precondition: observe radix-2/53-bit binary64, ties-to-even probes, minimum-subnormal preservation, and a BLAS minimum-subnormal matmul before granting authority
f64_authority_checker.dot_bound: gamma_(2k+1) times an outward upper bound on sum(abs(products)), plus (2k+1) minimum-subnormal
f64_authority_checker.pass_shortcut: when the certified inverse/operator lower ratio already exceeds tau_rank, use the universal ratio upper bound 1 and skip singular-vector proposal

q_nullspace.row_map: values first, then source_value_rows + dimension*global_gradient_index + component
q_nullspace.exact_basis: Q* = [-(P_top^T)^-1 P_tail^T; I] in exact rational arithmetic
q_nullspace.proof: P^T Q* is exact zero and the identity tail gives full structural column rank
q_nullspace.captured_q_requirement: finite, correctly shaped, identity tail implicit, and the exact-dyadic rational normalized P^T Q residual <= 2^-32
q_nullspace.operational_f64_residual: emit an analytic outward replay envelope as a diagnostic; the exact-dyadic rational residual is the stronger admission authority

requirements: bind the canonical JSON lock body
bind every declared artifact path, byte count, metadata tuple, and payload
reject missing, extra, aliased, or mismatched active records before semantics

M4-GEOMETRY-1K-RANK-INVALID-DUPLICATE.materialization: copy one declared binary64 coordinate row bit-for-bit over a distinct declared source row and bind both recipe and mutated coordinates in the immutable lock
M4-GEOMETRY-1K-RANK-INVALID-DUPLICATE.precondition: both source and destination are ordinary value rows absent from selected_polynomial_indices, and the bound model nugget is exact positive zero
M4-GEOMETRY-1K-RANK-INVALID-DUPLICATE.authority: the exact difference of the duplicate non-anchor value rows is a nonzero polynomial-nullspace tail direction annihilated by the projected operator

resource_preflight.logical_units: matrix elements retained concurrently by the checker
resource_preflight.timing: deny the complete semantic run before any artifact is materialized as an array or any derived rank subject is constructed
